mapper.insert: INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, role, content, status, model_id, sequence_no, error_code, generation_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{status}, #{modelId}, #{sequenceNo}, #{errorCode}, #{generationId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, role, content, status, model_id, sequence_no, error_code, generation_id, created_at, updated_at FROM messages WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE messages SET generation_id = #{generationId} WHERE id = #{id} AND generation_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence_no), 0) FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT id, conversation_id, role, content, status, model_id, sequence_no, error_code, generation_id, created_at, updated_at FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY sequence_no DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) recent ORDER BY sequence_no ASC
